title: Record implementation while preserving the proposed definition
preconditions: Disposable format-2 Saga has proposed Record store r1 and source store.go lines 4-6; retain exact source delivery commit.

steps.action: Revise store to implemented r2 with parent r1, save evidence at lines 4-6 and delivery commit; retry the identical command.
steps.expected_result: The retry is idempotent; r2 records delivery repository/commit and pinned evidence; r1 remains proposed.

steps.action: Propose r3 under the same identity, first using proposed r1 as baseline, then implemented r2.
steps.expected_result: The proposed baseline is refused and r2 is accepted as the retained implemented baseline.

steps.action: Pin current r3 from a slide and query the slide; attempt stale r2 without a saved view.
steps.expected_result: Slide retains exact r3; historical baseline admission requires an explicit saved view.

expected_result: Slide retains exact r3; historical baseline admission requires an explicit saved view.
